title: policy_parent_coverage_DOC_XXX.json -- whole-parent logical and physical page coverage v0.2
description: Produced by policy-pipeline for a physical policy parent document (e.g. CASE_030's 240-page 보험약관 PDF, DOC_001). The per-document boundary inventory only accounts for the pages a segment already owns; it structurally cannot see a page of the parent that was never carved into any segment at all -- exactly CASE_030's hole, where 133 of 240 logical pages (front matter 1-11, gap page 56, and the entire appendix/별표 region 120-240) belonged to no document and were invisible to the completeness gate. This contract closes that: every logical page of the parent PDF, 1..total_logical_pages, must appear exactly once with an explicit disposition. owned_by_segment/reference_table are the productive dispositions; administrative_excluded requires a concrete per-page reason (not a blanket 'appendix'); review_required/extraction_failed are unresolved and block policy_clause_processing finalize. The DAO cross-contract verifies the 1..N coverage is exact (no gap/dup/out-of-range) and that each owned_by_segment/reference_table disposition resolves to a really-registered segment or a really-present reference table.

parent_document_id.description: The physical policy parent whose full page range this contract accounts for. Must be a physical (non-segment) insurance_policy document in the manifest.

total_logical_pages.description: The parent PDF's total printed logical page count (e.g. 240). Every logical page 1..this value must be covered exactly once by a pages[] entry.

total_physical_pages.description: Physical PDF page count copied from document_manifest.source_total_pages. It is document-processing metadata, not a policy-agent self declaration.

unpaged_physical_pages.description: Physical pages with no printed logical N/total footer, such as covers. Together with pages[].physical_page these must cover 1..total_physical_pages exactly once.

physical_page.description: The parent PDF's 1-based physical page index (may differ from logical; CASE_030 offset is +7).

owner_document_id.description: For owned_by_segment: the segment/physical document that carries this page's processed text and normalized clauses. null otherwise.

table_uid.description: For reference_table: the table in reference_table_{owner}.json this page's appendix content was extracted into. null otherwise.

reference_table_document_id.description: For reference_table: the document_id whose reference_table_{id}.json holds table_uid. null otherwise.

reason.description: For administrative_excluded/review_required/extraction_failed: the concrete, page-specific reason. null for owned_by_segment/reference_table.

evidence_references.description: Page-level processed-source provenance for administrative exclusion. Productive dispositions are proven through owner/table contracts.
